data_fields.name: stack_key
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: item type plus subtype; name not compared; merge only when the new item is counted

best_idea: A move is all-or-nothing (a refused drop returns the item to its source slot), and stacks come from a key, so no item can be in two slots or in none.
decision_why: Refuse-and-return and the stack key fit server-verified loot, but the donor's two stores caused the no-room ghost item, so Frankendom keeps one ledger where a move commits only when the server accepts it.
acceptance: On a 375-wide phone, drop a bag item on an occupied slot: it snaps back and a server test asserts the same item ids and slot count before and after; with 24 bag slots full, a chest pickup is refused, the item stays in the chest, and a 'bag full' line shows for 2 s.
